result.reason: The clause provides up to 90 days of continued access at then-current fees, but it does not require Vendor transition assistance or a Customer Data export within 30 days, so it fails even the fallback. It also excludes transition rights following Licensee breach and adds record-retention and open-position concepts not required by the playbook. The unrelated termination framework is largely preserved, but drafting is weakened by treating access as assistance, omitting the export mechanism and deadline, and retaining the grammatical error “has complied.” The margin comment also references a prepaid-fee refund that is absent from the operative language.
